result.edit: Removed the duplicate 3'd6 case arm and added the missing begin/end around the case statement in the always block; the duplicate arm was unreachable and the missing block delimiters left the case outside the always body, causing the outputs to hold stale values (00) instead of the expected 01 at the divergence cycle.
result.replacement_rtl:
module JG3(ABC,X,Y);
	
	input [2:0] ABC;
	
	output X, Y;
	reg X, Y;
	
	always@(ABC)
	begin
		case(ABC)
			3'd0: begin X<=0;Y<=1; end
			3'd5: begin X<=1;Y=0; end
			3'd6: begin X<=1;Y=0; end
			default: begin X<=0;Y<=0; end
		endcase
	end
	
endmodule
